hiagent_budget_binding.question: do the ACEBench HiAgent b192/b256/b384 budgets bind, given identical 0.100 scores?
hiagent_budget_binding.finding: The budget binds on most requests and the three runs differ in request count, evictions and process accuracy, so they are not one run plus noise. End-to-end correctness is the same five task IDs at every budget; on these 50 tasks the end-to-end metric does not separate b192-b384.
